scope: CVG-002C2 inpatient daily-charge distinct-key PostgreSQL HTTP/UoW race

criteria.description: Equivalent distinct-key daily-charge requests converge through the public HTTP boundary without 500/25P02 and return the same successful response.
criteria.limitations: The proof is repository-local and disposable; it does not certify production topology or remote CI.

criteria.description: The expected source uniqueness race is recovered inside fixed repository savepoints, preserving the outer tenant transaction and exactly one billing record/item plus one billed daily charge.
criteria.limitations: The savepoint names are fixed repository constants and the existing database uniqueness contract is reused; no schema redesign is claimed.

criteria.description: Divergent source values retain typed conflict semantics and leave the pending daily charge unlinked with no additional source item.
criteria.limitations: The public HTTP route derives source values from the persisted daily-charge row; divergent values are therefore proven at the direct tenant-UoW/service boundary.

criteria.description: Same-key replay, rollback, cache recovery, tenant isolation, audit bootstrap isolation and the complete clinical-financial vertical remain green.
criteria.limitations: This is bounded regression evidence and does not close the parent CVG-002/CVG-002C acceptance.

criteria.description: Module/API/workspace tests, official coverage, typecheck/build and static security/schema/RLS/hygiene checks meet the project quality bar.
criteria.limitations: Coverage and static checks are local repository evidence and do not replace target, provider, production or release acceptance.

criteria.description: Independent bounded review approves the current slice, and fresh parity evidence preserves the explicit global non-promotion boundary.
criteria.limitations: Approval is bounded to this repository-local race; providers, target roles/RLS, production, deployment, release and global ERP remain unapproved.

next_action: Reconcile the control plane, then return to fresh residual scouting under a new authority. Keep parent CVG-002/CVG-002C2/global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.
